answer: Let new identities enter only by vouching: an established member must stake real value on each newcomer, the way porous karst slowly filters an underground river before it reaches the ocean. If a vouched account proves fake, the voucher stake is burned and their own standing sinks with it. Honest vouching costs little, but a Sybil farmer must corrupt many established members, each risking a stake that turns umber and worthless, or buy aged accounts at rising prices, until faking identities costs more than the rewards they could ever drain.
